$comment: Information architecture for the local conductor.build clone. Routes come from https://www.conductor.build/sitemap.xml (306 URLs, all on www.conductor.build). Section structure comes from CLONE_SPEC.md (homepage), CLONE_SPEC_PAGES.md (8 standalone pages) and CLONE_SPEC_DOCS.md (docs + changelog), all measured from the live site. implementedBy points at the clone's real React components. Hand-edit this file only; IA.md and matrix.csv are generated by build.mjs.

meta.mirror: Local React 18 + Vite + Tailwind v3 clone at http://localhost:5220
meta.generatedBy: ia-builder skill; routes from sitemap.xml, sections from CLONE_SPEC*.md

categories.SHELL: Site chrome and global overlays that appear on many routes: header, mobile menu, footer variants, download dialog.
categories.HERO: The opening block of a page: homepage hero, page title blocks.
categories.PROOF: Social proof: customer logo strips/grids and testimonials.
categories.FEATURES: Homepage product feature modules, each a titled shell with a live demo or image.
categories.CONTENT: The substantive body of a standalone page: plans, FAQ, prose articles, brand assets, team cards.
categories.CONVERSION: Blocks whose job is to capture a lead or a download: CTA band, contact forms.
categories.DOCS: Fumadocs-style documentation shell parts: sidebar, drawer, breadcrumb, body, TOC, search.
categories.CHANGELOG: Changelog listing, pagination and single-post parts.

shell.header.description: Sticky 57px marketing header: Conductor mark, nav links (Changelog, Docs, Pricing, Enterprise, Join Us), Sign in, and a dark Download button. The current route's nav link gets aria-current and full foreground colour. On docs routes it is hidden below 768px.
shell.header.scope: All 306 routes; on docs routes it only shows at 768px and wider.

shell.mobile-menu.description: Below 768px, the header's 36px menu button opens a dropdown panel of full-width rows (nav links plus a Download row that opens the download dialog).
shell.mobile-menu.scope: All 237 non-docs routes at mobile width; docs routes use shell.docs-subnav and docs.mobile-drawer instead.

shell.docs-subnav.description: Docs-only 56px top bar below 768px, translucent white with 8px backdrop blur: Conductor mark + wordmark on the left, search and open-sidebar icon buttons on the right. Replaces the marketing header on small screens.

shell.footer-sans.description: Site footer (link columns, copyright, SOC 2 note) rendered in the system sans stack, because the homepage wraps it in a font-mono→sans override.

shell.footer-mono.description: The same footer geometry, links and colours as the homepage, but rendered in real monospace because these routes are not inside the homepage's sans override wrapper.
shell.footer-mono.scope: Every route except the homepage (305 routes): standalone pages, docs and changelog.

shell.download-dialog.description: 448x294 modal to download the Mac app (Apple silicon primary button, Intel link, waitlist row). No enter/exit animation; first open in a page load is delayed ~300ms to match the original's Suspense reveal.
shell.download-dialog.scope: Reachable from the header Download button on all 306 routes, plus hero/pricing download buttons.

shell.downloading-screen.description: Full-screen black terminal-style overlay shown after any download click: scanlines, box-drawing frame, typewriter text with blinking cursor, number keys open docs/Discord/X.
shell.downloading-screen.scope: Reachable after a download click on all 306 routes.

hero.home.description: Homepage hero: masked sky background, animated-WebP wordmark mask, H1 that scrambles between three phrases every 3s, Get Conductor CTA with a quote, and the baked-frame app screenshot.

hero.pricing-title.description: Centered single H1 for the pricing page (36px/600), with no lead paragraph.

hero.page-header.description: Left-aligned page header: 36px/600 H1 with tight tracking and a muted 16px lead paragraph, in a 768px column (672px on team-plan).
hero.page-header.scope: 4 standalone pages: enterprise, team-plan, slack and join-us.

hero.brandkit-header.description: Brand-kit page header in an 836px column: mono uppercase 'Brand kit' eyebrow badge, H1, muted lead, then a short prose intro limited to 65ch.

proof.trusted-logo-strip.description: 'Trusted by 100k+ builders' heading with a count-up number (1400ms easeOutCubic, skipped if in view on load) over an 8-logo grid in a 672px column; Spotify logo tinted green.

proof.enterprise-logo-grid.description: Plain 8-logo grid inside the enterprise prose (4 columns, 3 on mobile) with a different logo set (adds Life360 and Reducto), no counter and an untinted Spotify logo, closed by a bottom border.

proof.testimonials.description: Grid of 6 testimonial cards with author, handle and verified badge; lazily mounted, each card fades up 16px over 500ms with a 50ms stagger.

features.multiplayer.description: Feature shell 'Ludwig has entered the chat.' with a looping multiplayer chat demo (typing bubbles, avatars with local-time tooltips).

features.cloud-sandbox.description: Feature shell 'A cloud sandbox for every agent.' with a phased sandbox demo: video, building/preparing/done states, a running timer and a shimmer loader.

features.byok.description: Feature shell 'Bring your own subscriptions and keys.' with a looping orchestration demo that steps through agent/tool phases.

features.anywhere.description: Feature shell 'Conduct from anywhere.' with a static device/dock image and macOS/iOS/API platform buttons.

content.changelog-preview.description: Homepage changelog teaser: 3 latest-release cards with version badge and date plus a 'View all' arrow link; horizontal scroller on mobile.

content.pricing-plans.description: Four plan cards (12px radius) in a 4/2/1-column grid; the Pro card carries a mono 'Most popular' badge; features use └ tree bullets; the Free card's Download opens the download dialog.

content.pricing-faq.description: Static (non-accordion) definition-list FAQ in a 576px column, answers as └ tree-bullet text.

content.prose-article.description: Tailwind-typography article in a 768px column, 40px below the page header: 16px/28px foreground body, headings with hover anchor-link icons, links weight 500 with a 55% underline that fade to 0.8 opacity on hover.
content.prose-article.scope: 3 standalone pages: enterprise (intro line), slack and join-us.

content.legal-prose.description: Legal document layout: the same prose article but with no page header and no top margin, its own 800-weight H1 with anchor icon, and section titles as bold paragraphs rather than headings.

content.join-us-apply-card.description: Dashed-border link card inside the join-us prose with a grey icon tile and arrow, linking out to the jobs page; hover fills with muted/50.

content.join-us-team-photo.description: Full-width 8px-radius team photo inside the join-us prose.

content.join-us-team-cards.description: Seven dashed team-member cards (avatar, name, role, short bio with links, X button) under the 'Our team' heading.

content.brandkit-download-card.description: Muted card with an archive icon tile, title and caption, and a dark 'Download ZIP' button for the full logo pack.

content.brandkit-asset-cards.description: Two-column grid of 4 logo preview cards (light and dark panels) each with SVG/PNG download links.

content.brandkit-about.description: 'About Conductor' stack: description and short-description cards with copy-to-clipboard buttons (no visual feedback), a facts list, agent-resource links and official links.

conversion.be-like-this-guy.description: Homepage closing CTA band headed 'Be like this guy.' with a download action.

conversion.enterprise-contact-form.description: Replica of the HubSpot contact-sales form (names, job title, company email, company name, company size, message) in the HubSpot theme. In the clone it validates locally and never posts anywhere.

conversion.team-plan-form-scrollbox.description: Same HubSpot field set but themed in Andale Mono and placed inside a fixed 450px scroll box that clips the lower half of the form (an original quirk). Local-only in the clone.

docs.sidebar.description: Sticky 268px desktop sidebar: root switcher popover (Reference / How to), search button with ⌘K hint, separators, collapsible folders (150ms) and active-page highlight.
docs.sidebar.scope: The 69 docs routes at 768px and wider.

docs.mobile-drawer.description: Right-side slide-in drawer (85% width, max 380px, 250ms) holding the same nav tree, opened from the docs subnav.

docs.breadcrumb.description: Non-linked breadcrumb of folder names separated by chevrons, 14px muted, horizontally scrollable.

docs.page-title.description: Docs page H1 plus its muted description paragraph.

docs.prose-body.description: MDX-style body rendered from extracted content: anchored headings, Shiki github-light code blocks with copy button, code tabs, callouts, steps, accordions, tables, image/video frames, YouTube embeds, cards, kbd shortcuts and a few site-specific interactive widgets.

docs.prev-next.description: Two-up previous/next page cards at the bottom of the article.

docs.toc.description: Right 'On this page' table of contents in the Fumadocs clerk style: scroll-spy with several headings active at once, an SVG track and a 4px dot following the rail.
docs.toc.scope: The 69 docs routes at 1280px and wider.

docs.search-dialog.description: ⌘K / Ctrl+K search overlay (300ms open) with keyboard-navigable result rows, driven in the clone by a local search index instead of the original /api/search endpoint.

changelog.entry-list.description: Up to 10 changelog articles per page; each has a sticky left meta column (mono version badge linking to the post, date) and a linked 30px title over a markdown body, separated by faint borders.
changelog.entry-list.scope: The 21 changelog index routes (/changelog and pages 2–21).

changelog.pagination.description: Two-row pager: Previous / 'Page N of 21' / Next, then page numbers showing first, last, current ±1 and ellipses.

changelog.back-link.description: Muted 'Back to changelog' link with a left arrow above a single post.

changelog.post-entry.description: Single changelog article: the same meta column (unlinked badge) and markdown body as the list, with an unlinked 30px H1 and no border, pager or prev/next.
